# Getting started

sqlpipe is a command-line tool. sqlpipe moves data between databases.

To install sqlpipe, run this command:

```
curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh
```

The command downloads sqlpipe and puts it on your system.

Next, make a configuration file with the name `sqlpipe.yaml`. This file gives the source database, the target database, and the tables to move. Put one connection in each section.

To start the first run, run this command:

```
sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml
```

sqlpipe reads the configuration file and moves the data. The tool shows the progress on the screen. When the run is complete, sqlpipe shows a summary of the rows.

If an error occurs, sqlpipe stops and shows the cause. Make sure that the connection values in `sqlpipe.yaml` are correct. Then start the run again.
